sections.title: Advanced French Composition and Conversation
sections.description: Summer in Tours course: Intensive language course complemented by various workshops to consolidate and deepen written and oral skills,do more targeted phonetic correction work (on expressive intonation, fluency and fluency) in a language lab or in class, discover different aspects of life in France, and to be open to the plurality of cultures. At the end of the program, students will be able to take the DELF.
